summary.text: BIGZ AS (926 451 669), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2021-01-11; address Skuteviksbodene 13, 5035 BERGEN, Norge. Main industry is Activities of advertising agencies (73.110); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Dan Endre Bigset; Board chair: Kristoffer Ålhus. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 1.93 m, operating profit NOK 148.54 k, net profit NOK 117.06 k, equity NOK 35.16 k, total assets NOK 438.65 k.
